paragraphs: Ek cell ya battery electrical energy ka source hai, aur current maintain karne ke liye source energy kharch karta rehta hai. Is energy ka kuch hissa useful work me use ho sakta hai, jaise electric fan ke blades ghumane me, aur baaki heat ke roop me kharch ho sakta hai; isi wajah se fan lambi der tak continuously use karne par warm ho jata hai.

Agar electric circuit purely resistive hai, yani sirf resistors ka configuration jo battery se connected hai, to source energy continuously poori tarah heat ke form me dissipate ho jati hai. Ise electric current ka heating effect kaha jata hai, aur yah electric heaters aur electric irons jaise devices me use hota hai.

Maan lijiye current I resistance R ke resistor se flow kar raha hai aur uske across potential difference V hai, aur time t me charge Q flow karta hai. Charge Q ko potential difference V ke through move karne me kiya gaya work VQ hai, isliye source ko time t me energy VQ supply karni padti hai, aur circuit me power input P = VQ/t = VI hai. Isliye source dwara time t me supplied energy VIt hai, aur yah energy resistor me heat ke roop me dissipate hoti hai, isliye H = VIt.

Is par Ohm's law V = IR apply karne se H = I²Rt milta hai. Yah Joule's law of heating hai, aur yah kehta hai ki kisi resistor me produce heat kisi diye gaye resistance ke liye current ke square ke directly proportional hoti hai, kisi diye gaye current ke liye resistance ke directly proportional hoti hai, aur jitni der current flow karta hai us time ke directly proportional hoti hai.

spec.title: H = VIt se Joule's law H = I²Rt tak

steps.title: Source dwara di gayi energy
steps.detail: Time t me charge Q flow hota hai, aur ise potential difference V ke through move karne me kiya gaya work VQ hai, isliye source time t me energy VQ supply karta hai.

steps.title: Power input likhiye
steps.detail: Kyunki I = Q/t, power input P = VQ/t = VI hai, isliye time t me supplied energy VIt hai.

steps.title: Yeh energy heat ban jati hai
steps.detail: Purely resistive circuit me yeh poori energy resistor me heat ke roop me dissipate ho jati hai, isliye H = VIt.

steps.title: V hataane ke liye Ohm's law use karein
steps.detail: H = VIt me V = IR rakhein, to H = (IR)It = I²Rt milta hai.

steps.title: Teen proportionalities samjhiye
steps.detail: Fixed resistance ke liye, heat current ke square ke proportional hoti hai; fixed current ke liye, heat resistance ke proportional hoti hai; aur dono fixed ho to heat time ke proportional hoti hai.

spec.problem: Ek electric iron maximum heating par 840 W rate se energy consume karta hai aur minimum heating par 360 W. Voltage 220 V hai. Har case mein current aur resistance kya hai?

steps.title: Power relation se shuru karein
steps.detail: Power input P = VI hai, isliye current I = P/V, aur resistance R = V/I se milti hai.

spec.answer: Maximum rate par current 3.82 A hai aur resistance 57.60 Ω; minimum rate par current 1.64 A hai aur resistance 134.15 Ω.

spec.problem: 100 J heat har second 4 Ω resistance mein produce hota hai. Resistor ke across potential difference nikalo.

steps.title: Jo given hai use likho
steps.detail: Heat H = 100 J, resistance R = 4 Ω, time t = 1 s. Humein V chahiye.

steps.title: Current nikalne ke liye Joule's law use karo
steps.detail: H = I²Rt, so I = square root of (H / (Rt)) = square root of (100 J / (4 Ω × 1 s)) = 5 A.

steps.title: Potential difference nikalo
steps.detail: Ohm's law se V = IR = 5 A × 4 Ω = 20 V.

spec.question: Ek electric iron jiska resistance 20 Ω hai, 5 A current leta hai. 30 s mein develop hone wala heat calculate karo. Answer joules mein do.
spec.explanation: Joule's law use karo: H = I²Rt = (5 A)² × 20 Ω × 30 s = 25 × 20 × 30 = 15000 J.
spec.expected_understanding: Learner current ka square karke resistance aur time se multiply karta hai.

paragraphs: Conductor mein heat ka generate hona electric current ka ek inevitable consequence hai, aur kai cases mein ye undesirable hota hai kyunki useful electrical energy heat mein badal jaati hai aur components garam ho jaate hain. Lekin heating effect ke kai useful applications hain: electric laundry iron, electric toaster, electric oven, electric kettle aur electric heater sab Joule's heating par based hain.

Electric bulb light produce karne ke liye heating ka use karta hai. Filament ko generated heat ka jitna possible ho utna retain karna chahiye taaki wo bahut hot ho jaye aur light emit kare, aur us temperature par melt na ho. High melting point wali strong metal, jaise tungsten (melting point 3380 °C), bulb filaments ke liye use hoti hai, filament ko insulating supports se as much as possible thermally isolate kiya jaata hai, aur filament ki life badhane ke liye bulb ko chemically inactive nitrogen aur argon gases se fill kiya jaata hai. Filament jo power consume karta hai uska most part heat ke roop mein appear hota hai, aur sirf small part light ke roop mein radiate hota hai.

Fuse Joule's heating ka another common application hai. Ye circuits aur appliances ko kisi bhi unduly high current ke flow ko rok kar protect karta hai, aur device ke saath series mein lagaya jaata hai. Ye appropriate melting point wale metal ya alloy ki wire ka ek piece hota hai, for example aluminium, copper, iron ya lead, usually porcelain ya similar material ke cartridge mein metal ends ke saath encased hota hai. Agar specified value se larger current flow hota hai, to fuse wire ka temperature rise hota hai, wire melt hoti hai aur circuit break ho jaata hai.

Domestic purposes ke liye fuses 1 A, 2 A, 3 A, 5 A, 10 A, aur so on rated hote hain, aur rating appliance jo current draw karta hai usse choose karni hoti hai. Electric iron jo 220 V par operate karne par 1 kW electric power consume karta hai, uske liye circuit mein (1000/220) A, yaani 4.54 A, current flow karega. Is case mein 5 A fuse use karna chahiye: fuse wire sirf tab melt hoti hai jab uski specified value se larger current flow hota hai, isliye rating working current 4.54 A ke above honi chahiye, aur 3 A too low hoga.

spec.question: Ek electric iron 220 V par operate hone par 1 kW electric power consume karta hai. Iske saath kaun sa fuse rating use karna chahiye?
spec.answer: 5 A
spec.explanation: Circuit mein (1000/220) A, yani 4.54 A, current flow karta hai. Fuse wire sirf tab pighalta hai jab uske specified value se zyada current flow ho, isliye 3 A fuse working current se kam hoga aur 5 A fuse hi use karna chahiye.
spec.expected_understanding: Learner appliance ka working current nikalta hai aur uske bilkul upar wala fuse rating chunta hai, neeche wala nahi.

paragraphs: Karya karne ki dar power hai, aur yah energy ke consumption ki bhi dar hai. Electric circuit mein electric energy jis dar se dissipate ya consume hoti hai use electric power kehte hain, aur yah P = VI se di jaati hai. Ohm's law ka use karke ise P = I²R ya P = V²/R bhi likha ja sakta hai.

Electric power ka SI unit watt (W) hai. Yah us device dwara consume ki gayi power hai jo 1 V ke potential difference par operate hone par 1 A current carry karta hai, isliye 1 W = 1 volt × 1 ampere = 1 V A.

Watt bahut chhota unit hai, isliye actual practice mein hum kilowatt naam ka kaafi bada unit use karte hain, jo 1000 watts ke barabar hai. Electrical energy power aur time ka product hai, isliye iska unit watt hour (W h) hai, yani 1 watt power ko 1 hour tak use karne par consume hone wali energy. Electric energy ka commercial unit kilowatt hour (kW h) hai, jise aam taur par unit kaha jata hai: 1 kW h = 1000 watt × 3600 second = 3.6 × 10^6 watt second = 3.6 × 10^6 joule.

Ek savdhani: kai log sochte hain ki electric circuit mein electrons consume ho jate hain. Yah galat hai. Hum electricity board ya electric company ko isliye pay karte hain taaki ve electric bulb, fan aur engines jaise gadgets ke through electrons ko move karne ke liye energy dein; hum us energy ke liye pay karte hain jo hum use karte hain.

Power relation ka use karo

spec.problem: Ek electric refrigerator jiski rating 400 W hai, 8 hour/day chalta hai. Isse 30 days tak chalane ki energy ka cost kya hoga at Rs 3.00 per kW h?

steps.title: Watt hours mein total energy find karein
steps.detail: 400 W × 8.0 hour/day × 30 days = 96000 W h.

steps.title: Kilowatt hours mein convert karein
steps.detail: 96000 W h = 96 kW h, since 1 kW h = 1000 W h.

steps.title: Rate se multiply karein

spec.question: In terms mein se kaun sa circuit mein electrical power ko represent nahi karta?
spec.answer: IR²
spec.explanation: Electric power P = VI hota hai; jab V = IR rakhte hain to P = I²R ban jata hai, aur jab I = V/R rakhte hain to P = V²/R ban jata hai. Combination IR² mein I aur R ki powers galat hain, isliye ye power nahi hai.

spec.question: Resistance R wala ek piece of wire paanch equal parts mein cut kiya jata hai. Ye parts phir parallel mein connect kiye jate hain. Agar is combination ki equivalent resistance R' hai, to ratio R/R' kya hai?
spec.explanation: Paanch equal parts mein se har ek ki resistance R/5 hoti hai. Aise paanch resistors parallel mein hain to 1/R' = 5/(R/5) = 25/R, isliye R' = R/25. Isliye R/R' = 25.
spec.expected_understanding: Learner wire ko cut karne ke effect (length kam hoti hai, isliye resistance kam hoti hai) ko parallel rule ke saath combine karta hai.

spec.question: Ek electric bulb 220 V aur 100 W rated hai. Jab ise 110 V par operate kiya jata hai, to ye kitni power consume karega?
spec.explanation: Bulb ka resistance fixed hai: R = V²/P = (220 V)² / 100 W = 484 Ω. 110 V par power P = V²/R = (110 V)² / 484 Ω = 25 W. Voltage half hone se power quarter ho jati hai, kyunki fixed resistance ke liye power V² ke proportional hoti hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Learner rating se resistance nikalta hai aur phir naye voltage par power recompute karta hai.

spec.question: Same material ki do conducting wires, jinki lengths aur diameters barabar hain, ko pehle series mein aur phir parallel mein same potential difference ke across ek circuit mein connect kiya jata hai. Series combination mein produce hui heat aur parallel combination mein produce hui heat ka ratio kya hai?
spec.explanation: Har wire ki resistance R hai. Series mein resistance 2R hoti hai; parallel mein ye R/2 hoti hai. Same potential difference V aur same time t ke liye, heat V²t/R hoti hai, isliye ye resistance ke inversely proportional hoti hai. Heats ka ratio (1/2R) : (1/(R/2)) = 1 : 4 hota hai.
spec.expected_understanding: Learner dekhta hai ki fixed source voltage ke liye, chhoti resistance zyada heat produce karti hai.

spec.question: 220 V line par 5 A carry karne ke liye kitne 176 Ω resistors (parallel mein) chahiye?
spec.explanation: Combination ka resistance R = V/I = 220 V / 5 A = 44 Ω hona chahiye. Agar 176 Ω ke n resistors parallel mein jode jayein, to R = 176/n, isliye n = 176/44 = 4.
spec.expected_understanding: Learner required current se required equivalent resistance tak backwards kaam karta hai, phir identical resistors ke liye parallel rule use karta hai.
